text:
Collin Graf scored 21 goals last season as an undrafted second-year player, and this season has gone the other way. Three points in 19 games, nothing in his last eight, and San Jose Hockey Now's headline says he's not happy with his start and trying to stay positive.

Our read is mixed. For the season he's due: two goals on 4.2 expected, and the Sharks are about five points of expected goal share better with him on the ice than off it. But over the recent eight-game drought the chances have thinned out too, so this isn't only bad luck. He's playing more, up about a minute and a half a night lately, and still not getting to the same spots.

The longer track record is better than this. Evolving-Hockey had him worth 1.2 wins last season, mostly from even-strength offense, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows 52% of his shots come off the rush, so he needs a team that gets the puck going the other way. Our range has him at 10 to 21 goals over a full season. One good week changes the conversation.
headline: Graf's slow start
